protocol.ordering: case-major; condition order rotates by per-task case index; stateless requests
protocol.surface_factor: surface added to each card from its original pack binding
protocol.policy_fields_factor: same cards partitioned into resolved_terms and ambiguous_mentions.candidates
limitations: 14 synthetic cases; no model or deployment-quality claim.
Missing cases have no cards, so their surface factor is inert.
The policy-field representation retains definition and status card keys.
Exact QA matching; paraphrases need a separate blind review.

hypotheses: Adding an exact surface binding changes answerable-case success or over-abstention.
Using policy-named fields changes answerable-case success or over-abstention.
The joint condition can differ from either single factor.
analysis_scope: Descriptive paired2x2 on14syntheticcases; no significance, population error bound or full-production-pack score.
model_identity_limit: Same served ID and three unchanged config hashes observed before run; checkpoint revision/weight content not verified.
